items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: They had a guest soloist, Ella Fitzgerald? It was either Ella Fitzgerald -- I'm sure it was Ella Fitzgerald or, at that time, Sarah Vaughn.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, because she had been working with Earl Hines at about that time, right?

She was singing like a mockingbird. I'm sure it was Sarah Vaughn. It wasn't Ella. Man, that was it. That thing, recording anybody -- nobody thought to record it. If that had been recorded, you could demand any amount of money you wanted for that, you know.
